title: Trainable Boundary-Keeping Where No Formal Answer Exists: A Controlled Knock-In Study of Reward Training in Evidence-Sufficiency Judgment
abstract: arXiv:2610.35226v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. We test this in evidence-sufficiency judgment: deciding whether available information actually supports a causal claim, a domain with no decidable correctness reward. Using a pre-registered, same-base, controlled knock-in design, we compare a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) with its own baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning model under an action-pressure protocol with no evaluation invitation. All load-bearing outcomes are rated by two separate model-rating sessions masked to arm labels; automatic judges only trigger. The trained arm raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson 95% CI lower bound 91.2%, non-overlapping with the baseline interval [14.2%, 40.2%]), while the scrambled placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited

translated_title: 在无正式答案之处实现可训练的边界保持：证据充分性判断中奖励训练的受控敲入研究
translated_abstract: 经过推理调优和奖励训练的模型通常被认为验证更可靠，因为它们推理时间更长或接收到了正确性信号。我们在证据充分性判断任务中检验了这一假设：即判断现有信息是否真正支持某个因果主张——这是一个不存在可判定正确性奖励的领域。我们采用预注册、同源底座模型的受控敲入设计，在无评估邀请的行动压力协议下，将一种边界保持训练配方（先SFT后GRPO）与其自身基线、一种乱序配对安慰剂组以及一个通用推理模型进行比较。所有承重结局均由两次独立的、对分组标签设盲的模型评分会话进行评定；自动评判器仅用于触发。训练组将自发的正确拒绝率从25%提升至100%（每组40例；Wilson 95%置信区间下界为91.2%，与基线区间[14.2%, 40.2%]不重叠），而乱序安慰剂组则崩溃（自发拒绝率5% / 受邀拒绝率7.5%）
tldr: 该研究通过预注册的同底座受控敲入实验证明，在不存在可判定正确性奖励的证据充分性判断任务中，“先SFT后GRPO”的边界保持训练配方能将模型的自发正确拒绝率从25%提升至100%，而乱序配对的安慰剂组则完全失效。
en_tdlr: This pre-registered, same-base controlled knock-in study shows that a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) raises models' spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% in evidence-sufficiency judgment—a domain with no decidable correctness reward—while a scrambled-pairing placebo collapses.
